pheidippides-marathon-run.description: A man in a tattered, sleeveless off-white tunic runs barefoot down a dusty, rocky hillside path, one arm thrown up and a strained expression on his face, kicking up dust. Behind him on the left, a walled hilltop citadel with classical-looking buildings sits across a distant plain under a dark, stormy sky with a warm light break near the horizon. There is no visible text, border, or frame; the painting fills the whole image in a dark oil style.

cursus-publicus-founded.description: A tired-looking man in a short tunic, dark cloak and sandals, with a leather satchel across his chest, steps down from or beside a sweating dark horse on a cobbled yard at night. A second man on the right leads out a fresh horse by the reins. Stone arched doorways, timber-braced walls, a wall torch, a hanging lantern and a brazier fill the setting. Oil-painting style, no text, no frame, no gore.

mongol-yam-relay-network.description: A man in a fur-trimmed hat and dark deel robe rides a galloping brown horse across open grassland under a stormy sky, leaning forward over the reins. A silver plaque hangs on his chest. In the background, felt yurts and several tethered horses stand near a few small figures, with a flag on a pole. No visible text. The painting runs edge to edge in an oil-painting style.

beacon-chain-armada-warning.description: A man in a wide-brimmed hat and dark coat leans forward and thrusts a burning torch into an iron fire basket on a tall wooden post, at the edge of a cliff above a stormy grey sea. Sparks fly and smoke rises into a dark, cloudy sky. On a distant headland to the right, a second small fire burns with a thin plume of smoke. There are no visible letters, frames or borders, and the painting runs edge to edge.

royal-mail-opens-to-public.description: A man with a white lace collar and dark doublet hands a wax-sealed letter across a wooden table to a woman in a black headscarf and dark dress. A leather satchel of letters sits on the table, with a quill, inkwell and scattered coins, and a lit candle stands between them. A brass post horn hangs from a timber beam in a dim, low-ceilinged wooden room, with shadowy figures in hats in the background. No visible text, frame or border.

first-mail-coach-bath-london.description: Painting of a red and black stagecoach pulled by two bay horses on a muddy road at dusk. A guard in a red coat and tricorn hat blows a long brass post horn from the rear, and a driver in a dark coat and hat holds the reins on the box. A trunk is strapped on the roof and lanterns are lit on the coach. The sky is stormy and dark with an orange sunset glow, and a crest is on the door. Oil-painting style, no visible text, no visible frame.

chappe-semaphore-line.description: A stone tower on a rocky ridge with a tall wooden mast topped by a crossbar and two angled hinged arms. A man in a tricorn hat and long coat stands on a wooden platform beside it, peering through a brass telescope. Behind him a valley opens under heavy grey clouds, and a second small tower with a cross-like arm sits on a far hill.

cooke-wheatstone-telegraph.description: A dark oil painting of a wooden cabinet with a diamond-shaped board carrying five pivoted needles over faint grid marks, with copper coils, brass terminals and cables at its base. Through a window at right a steam locomotive runs along a track beside telegraph poles. In the foreground are an ink bottle, a quill, a brass key and sheets of illegible handwriting. No border or frame; the painting fills the image.

pony-express-launches.description: A man in a dark wide-brimmed hat and dark work clothes leans from a dark bay horse with a white blaze, reaching across to a second bay horse with a saddle, while holding a leather saddle bag with pockets. A second man in a hat and waistcoat holds the second horse's bridle at the right. They stand in a dusty yard beside a dim log cabin with a glowing lantern on the wall, under a dark, dusky sky with flat plains on the left.

rural-free-delivery-begins.description: A painted scene: a man in a dark coat and hat leans out of the open back of a covered wooden wagon pulled by a brown horse, posting a white envelope into a weathered roadside mailbox on a wooden post. A muddy dirt track runs past dry grass, with a farmhouse, barn and bare trees on the horizon under a grey sky.

marconi-transatlantic-radio-signal.description: A painted oil scene in a dim, rough stone room. A man in a dark suit, seen from the side with his head bowed, holds a earpiece to one ear with his hand. On a wooden table sit brass-terminal wireless boxes, coils, a glass tube component and loose wires, lit by an oil lamp. Through a window, a stormy grey sky with a small kite-like shape over dark hills. No visible text, frame or border; the painting fills the image edge to edge.

first-official-airmail-flight.description: A painterly, dark sepia scene of an early open-cockpit biplane with wood-and-fabric wings and exposed struts, lifting off low over a wide river. A pilot sits in the open seat with bundled sacks beside him. Below, a crowd stands along the bank in front of a field of canvas tents and small pennant flags. The sky is murky and the light is warm and glowing near the water.

cher-ami-pigeon-message.description: A grey pigeon with spread wings flies over a smoky, burning battlefield with dead tree stumps and shell craters. A small metal canister is tied to one of its legs, and streaks of fire or shells cross the dark sky. No text, frame or people are visible.

transatlantic-radiotelephone-service.description: A man in a dark three-piece suit with slicked-back hair looks alarmed, eyes wide and mouth open. He holds a black candlestick-style telephone handset in one hand and presses a receiver to his ear with the other. He stands in a dark wooden booth with a glass-paned door. On the walls, framed seascapes show ocean liners with multiple funnels on rough grey-blue water. There is no legible text.

china-clipper-pacific-airmail.description: A grey four-engined flying boat with propellers spinning hovers over dark water beneath a stormy, golden-lit sky. A suspension bridge with two tall towers stretches across the background. In the foreground, men in work clothes load burlap sacks through the open hatch of a dark launch. Painterly, moody style with no visible text.

tat-1-transatlantic-telephone-cable.description: A dark, stormy night at sea. A ship's stern edge is lit by warm lanterns, and a large grooved wheel or drum with a thick dark cable wound on it sits at the right. A heavy cable with a bulging cylindrical casing hangs off the side and runs down into churning, white-capped waves. Four or five crew in dark oilskins and sou'westers work the rails and handle long poles. A faint figure stands on an upper deck at the top right. No visible text, no frame.

zip-codes-introduced.description: A dark oil painting of a mid-century mail sorting hall. A man in a work shirt sits at a sorting console reading an envelope, with conveyor belts, pigeonhole shelves, mail sacks and a cart around him and other workers in the haze behind. Envelopes carry only faint illegible squiggles, with no readable words, numbers or logos. The painting fills the frame edge to edge with no border.

dhl-express-courier-founded.description: A man in a dark suit and tie sits in an airplane cabin, looking out an oval window at a harbor with palm trees, a few ships and calm water under a warm, hazy sky. He rests his hands on a dark leather satchel, with papers tucked in its flap. The cabin has patterned seat fabric, overhead panels and a mid-century airliner look. No visible text, numbers or signature. The painting runs edge to edge with no frame or wall. Nothing violent or nude.

fedex-first-deliveries.description: A night airport apron under bright floodlights. A sleek, dark business jet stands with its rear cabin door open and steps down, with a figure on the stairs. Several workers in dark work clothes push carts stacked with cardboard boxes across the wet tarmac. Other small jets and ground vehicles sit in the background. No visible text, lettering, frame or border.

western-union-ends-telegrams.description: A dim, oil-painted study of an old office. A typewriter-like machine sits under a dark draped cloth on a worn wooden desk, and a long paper strip spills from it and curls over the desk edge. A shaft of light falls through a multi-pane window on the right onto a blank hanging wooden sign. An ink bottle and loose papers lie on the desk and scattered on the floor. No legible text is visible.

amazon-first-drone-delivery.description: A six-rotor black drone hovers under a dark, stormy sky with a shaft of light breaking through the clouds, carrying a plain cardboard box slung beneath it. Below is a thatched cottage with a brick chimney and ivy, set in a green field, with a flat board lying on the grass in the foreground. The painting is loose and textured, in oil style, and fills the whole image with no visible text.
